fields.summary_ko.0: Advantest (JP3122400009) raised its fiscal 2026 revenue outlook on October 28 from JPY 1,714.0 trillion to JPY 1,863.0 trillion, and operating profit from JPY 84.6 billion to JPY 96.7 billion, trading at EUR 209.90
fields.summary_ko.1: First half net profit (ended September 30) of JPY 368.1 billion (116.8% increase) and operating profit of JPY 456.8 billion (96.5% increase) reflect excess demand due to increased complexity of AI-related semiconductors and memory supply shortage
